name: aurora-drift
_comment: Showcase: multi-color generative ambient. A gradient bed plus two
noise fields, each with its own multi-stop palette AND its own
palette_speed (cycles/sec) at incommensurate rates, so the whole
field's hue mix continuously reorganizes rather than looping on a
short fixed period -- no two moments look the same over hours.
Ring-space: gradient scale = ring length so it tiles seamlessly.
